official_page_observation: The current Hemphill County Hospital District page identifies the district at 1020 S. 4th Street, Canadian, TX 79014 and links Cost of Services to the Sliced Health pricing portal.
browser_observation: The permitted browser rendered the Sliced Health Price Transparency Tool, loaded Hemphill County Hospital District as the facility, and exposed a Standard Charges / Export Machine Readable File control. Activating the control in this client did not expose a stable file URL or downloadable bytes.
pointer_observation: The previously recorded co.hemphill.tx.us domain was not used as evidence of current availability; the current first-party site is hchdst.org. No current root cms-hpt.txt response or direct MRF URL was recovered.
interpretation: The current operator and facility identity are supported and the discovery gap is narrowed to a live pricing portal. Portal UI alone is not evidence of MRF identity, CMS schema, freshness or attestation. No third-party file was assigned and no compliance conclusion was inferred.
next_action: Capture the portal's Standard Charges export endpoint or downloaded bytes using a download-capable browser/client, then validate facility name, address, state, NPI/license, CMS version, last_updated_on and attestation before promotion.
